character.description: Exact accepted body-only SwordReady v002 frame0 identity; original native219 supplies only four Hurt poses; targeted nearhand closure, common bare cloth body.

hurt.action:
REFERENCE OWNERSHIP IS STRICT. Image1 accepted body-only SwordReady v002 frame0 is the SOLE RIGHT three-quarter identity: exactly its rigid squat crooked clock/bell helmet, knob, enclosed black opening, two contained amber eyes, gray/charcoal plain cloth body, original belt, brown gloves and brown shoes, proportions, palette and hand-ink density. Do not redraw a different hero or change body/head/shoe scale. Image2 is only the standard count/spacing/padding guide. Image3 is original native219 Hurt4 ONLY for four-pose motion and pose continuity: compression, backward peak recoil, return, upright recovery; preserve corresponding torso/hip lean, rigid helmet tilt, knees, boot-support silhouette, connected elbows/wrists and the existing forward/backward rhythm. The open foreground near hand in native219 pose1 is an identified ERROR, not an approved vocabulary to repeat. No other original base/canonical131/oldv006 body is a reference.

This is a targeted NEAR-HAND GRIP correction, not a new hurt choreography. In ALL FOUR frames the foreground near glove must be genuinely closed in a plausible retained singlehand military-sword-hilt grasp: connected palm and wrist, curled opposing thumb and fingers visibly wrapping a cylindrical grip space, natural finger volume and a continuous short arm/elbow/forearm. No flat open palm, splayed star fingers, pinching fingertips, disconnected mitten, extra hand, fused pair of hands or hidden substitute hand. Keep the corresponding219 near-wrist location/arm direction and recoil as far as anatomy permits; alter only the finger closure and the minimum necessary local wrist articulation. Do not drag all four grips to one fixed Ready coordinate or copy/paste any Ready hand/mask. The far hand remains a separate natural balancing/impact-response hand; it need not grip, and may follow its corresponding219 natural pose. Do not turn this into a doublehand hold.

Paint only the complete BARE BODY. No visible sword, hilt, shaft, handle fragment, rod, shield, crossbow, staff, armor chest/caps/bracers/shins, guide lines or socket dots. A later real independent sword will be composed for contact inspection; exact Grip, handle Axis, hidden bones, hand masks and floor/root are UNKNOWN until actual new pixels are measured. A closed empty glove is a source candidate, not automatic proof of weapon contact. Preserve a common drawing scale across the whole row; do not normalize different pose bboxes, stretch the helmet, lengthen arms, enlarge the compressed pose or shrink the upright pose. Native actor/root movement is external; no ground, shadows, trails, blur, impact stars, glow, particles or decorative effects.

Ordered poses at the unchanged10fps: Pose0 (0.00s): same219 immediate compression, folded shoulders and flexed knees, nearhand closed while remaining anatomically connected near the abdomen; keep both hands distinct. Pose1 (0.10s): same219 strongest backward lean/recoil and shoe support, CLOSE the previously open near glove into a believable retained hilt grasp with thumb opposition and curled fingers; retain the recoil and wrist/forearm continuity, not a Ready arm. Pose2 (0.20s): same219 rebalance toward support, keep nearhand closed with the naturally changing wrist angle and separate farhand. Pose3 (0.30s): same219 final recovery toward standing, nearhand still closed, preserve residual hurt posture; not a copied Ready0. Exactly4 complete distinct poses,4x100ms=.40s, nonloop. Do not add a fifth pose, idle cycle or held recoil. This body row is for real nonlethal player poise break; ordinaryHP flash/DoT does not authorize gameplayHurt. Timing and game rules are references only, never draw them.
